name: Camera Folder
tagline: Allows all jpg apps to take a photo from the camera and process it.
blurb: When "Camera Folder" is installed, any Android app that can open jpg files can also take a photo from camera.
description:
When "Camera Folder" is installed, any Android app that
can open jpg files can also take a photo from camera.

Note that "Camera Folder" has no user interface and no
start icon of its own.

The app is super tiny: 0.16 MB

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
